assertions.evidence: incident_urgency.py has no score question with ordered levels; urgency comes from regex keyword weights compared against URGENCY_THRESHOLDS = ((11, 5), (8, 4), (5, 3), (2, 2)), and no decision model is called.
No decision model is ever called, so there are no returned scores or level probabilities; the urgency value is a threshold lookup on a locally summed regex score.
There is no decision-model state at all; `rate_incident(report, service)` takes plain function arguments and even merges them into one string via `combined = f"{service.strip()} {report.strip()}"`.
